title: Bamberg Baskets win the 2026 BBL Cup!
description: Bamberg Baskets have won the 2026 BBL Cup ending a seven-year title drought. In the final of the Top Four tournament in Munich, Bamberg defeated Alba Berlin 74â€“72 in a dramatic contest. It marked the clubâ€™s first trophy since their previous cup triumph in 2019. Alba controlled the boards with a 44â€“26 rebounding advantage but could not capitalize in the closing moments. Demarcus Demonia (201-G/F-1999, college: ETAMU) was named man of the match after scoring 19 points, including the decisive basket late in the game. For Berlin, Malte Delow (197-SF-2001) led the scoring with 17 points.

title: Bayern beat Ulm in Game 5, repeat as BBL champions
description: Bayern - Ulm 81-77 Bayern celebrated the decisive third win in the BBL Finals tonight. They held off Ulm to defend the trophy. Devin Booker (205-F/C-1991, college: Clemson) stepped up with 19 points to pace the champions. Bayern looked the better part in the first period. The hosts sank 28 points in the first quarter to take a 7-point lead. The teams exchanged baskets throughout the second term. Bayern ensured a 48-41 halftime advantage. But Ulm pulled closer in the third stanza. The visitors got within 4 points at the final intermission. Ulm opened the fourth quarter with 7 points in a row to pull ahead. They were up by two 75-73 midway through the quarter. However Bayern ignited an 8-2 rally to close the regulation and sealed the decisive victory at the end. Shabazz Napier (185-PG-1991, college: UConn, agency: Alti Sport) produced 15 points, while Johannes Voigtmann (211-F/C-1992) had…
imageCaption: Bayern beat Ulm in Game 5, repeat as BBL champions (Photo: Bayern)

title: Bayern crowned BBL champions
description: ALBA Berlin - Bayern 82-88 Bayern Munich lifted BBL trophy. They overcame ALBA Berlin in Game 4 of the Final to claim League title. Carsen Edwards (185-G-1998, college: Purdue) was unstoppable with 29 points. He was named the MVP. Bayern eked out a 22-21 lead after ten minutes. But ALBA sank 25 points in the second term to secure a 46-44 halftime advantage. However the visitors turned the tables in the third quarter. Bayern used a massive 21-6 run to silence the hosts. ALBA poured in 30 points in the fourth quarter but it was too late as Bayern rolled to the title. Leandro Bolmaro (198-G/F-2000) and Devin Booker (205-F/C-1991, college: Clemson) produced 10 points each for Bayern. Sterling Brown (197-G-1995, college: SMU) responded with 25 points for ALBA. Yannick Wetzell (206-C-1996, college: SDSU) had 11 points in the loss.
imageCaption: Bayern crowned BBL champions (Photo: FC Bayern)

title: Ratiopharm Ulm clinch first ever BBL title
description: Ratiopharm Ulm - Bonn 74-70 Ratiopharm Ulm conquered their first BBL title tonight. They prevailed against Telekom Baskets Bonn in Game 4 of the Finals to lift the historic trophy. Yago Matheus (175-PG-1999) stepped up with 25 points and 8 assists for the champions. Bonn eked out a 23-21 lead ten minutes into the game. Ulm managed to pull ahead in the second stanza. The hosts snatched a 43-41 halftime advantage. Bonn were back in the driver's seat in the third period. They used an 18-8 run to comfortably lead by 8 points at the final intermission. But ratiopharm Ulm responded with a decisive 23-11 run in the fourth term and sealed the winning outcome. Brandon Paul (193-F/G-1991, college: Illinois, agency: Pensack Sports) accounted for 15 points for the hosts. TJ Shorts (175-PG-1997, college: UC Davis) answered with 19 points, while Jeremy Morgan (196-SG-1995, college: UNI) had 13 points…
imageCaption: Ratiopharm Ulm clinch first ever BBL title (Photo: BBL)

title: ALBA Berlin conquer BBL title
description: Bayern - ALBA 81-96 ALBA Berlin clinched BBL title. They overcame Bayern in Munich to lift the trophy tonight. The game was mostly controlled by ALBA Berlin. Bayern Muenchen managed to win fourth quarter 27-20. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. ALBA Berlin shot the lights out from three sinking 14 long-distance shots on high 51.9 percentage. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 29 assists comparing to just 11 passes made by Bayern Muenchen's players. Worth to mention a great performance of American point guard Jaleen Smith (193-1994, college: UNH) who helped to win the game recording 23 points (on 8-of-10 shooting from the field) and the international center Johannes Thiemann (206-1994, agency: BeoBasket) who added 15 points and 4 assists during the contest. Thiemann was named the Finals MVP. At the losing side American Augustine Rubit…
imageCaption: ALBA Berlin conquer BBL title (Photo: basketeurope.com)

title: ALBA Berlin earn easyCredit BBL title
description: Bayern - ALBA 79-86 ALBA Berlin clinched BBL title. They defeated Bayern in Munich tonight to win the championship series 3-1. The guests started the game with a very strong first quarter 21-9. But Bayern Muenchen won second period 21-17. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. ALBA Berlin made 26-of-32 free shots (81.3 percent) during the game. 29 personal fouls committed by Bayern Muenchen helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. Uruguayan-Italian guard Jayson Granger (189-89) fired 29 points for the winners. He was named the Finals MVP. Swedish guard Marcus Eriksson (201-93) chipped in 15 points. Granger is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market. ALBA Berlin's coach Aito Garcia Reneses used a ten-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next…
